plan: I think the target is the classical Gyāna/Chin mudrā: the index fingertip touches the thumb fingertip to form a circle, while the other three fingers (middle, ring, little) are extended and held close together, palm facing the audience, fingers pointing up. To reproduce: curl the index (mcp/pip/dip) so its tip meets the thumb; oppose the thumb across to touch the index tip (moderate thumb_cmc flex and thumb_ip flex); keep middle, ring, little mostly extended (low mcp/pip/dip flex) with small abduction to hold them together; orient the whole hand upright with minimal roll/pitch/yaw so the palm faces the front camera.

plan:
I think the target is the classical Indian dance mudra 'Katakamukha' (a small ring formed by thumb, index and middle). Required placements:
- Thumb: flexed across the palm to meet the tips of index and middle (thumb_cmc_flex moderately positive around 30-50°, thumb_cmc_abd slightly negative to press toward index, thumb_mcp and thumb_ip flexed).
- Index and Middle: tips bent to touch the thumb tip — MCP flexed moderately (40-70°), PIP flexed high (60-100°), DIP flexed to bring tips (30-60°). Slight inward (negative) F_abd to close fingers together.
- Ring and Little: curled into the palm (MCP and PIP strongly flexed, PIP maybe 80-110°) so they don’t stick out; little may be tucked more than ring. Little F_abd slightly positive (toward thumb side) or neutral depending on look.
- Overall hand orientation: palm mostly facing the camera, with a small roll bringing the thumb slightly forward and a slight pitch to show the curled fingertips (pitch a bit negative to tip fingers away from camera?).
I will start by closing the fingers: flex index, middle, ring, little MCP/PIP/DIP and flex the thumb across; then fine-tune orientation with small turns and any adjustments. I will set initial joint targets and then look to compare with the target.

plan:
I believe the gesture is a loose 'claw' / cupped hasta: all four fingers are curled downward forming a rounded claw, fingertips oriented toward the viewer and slightly inward, not touching the palm. The thumb opposes across the front of the fingers, curled so the thumb tip comes near the index/middle area but not pressing tightly. Specific target joint placements (approx):
- Index: mcp ~70°, pip ~70°, dip ~30°, abd ~5° (slightly toward thumb)
- Middle: mcp ~75°, pip ~80°, dip ~40°, abd ~0°
- Ring: mcp ~70°, pip ~75°, dip ~35°, abd ~-3°
- Little: mcp ~65°, pip ~70°, dip ~30°, abd ~-10° (slightly toward little side)
- Thumb: cmc_flex ~35°, cmc_abd ~-10° (thumb placed across index side), cmc_rot ~10°, mcp ~25°, ip ~30°
Hand orientation: pitch ~10° (fingers tipped slightly toward camera), yaw ~15° (tilted so fingers point a bit to image right), roll ~0°.
I will iteratively set joints in safe steps (<=45° per call) and adjust orientation until the front and three-quarter views match the target. I will start by curling MCPs and PIPs in stages and bring thumb across, then fine-tune dips, spreads and hand turn.
